result.stderr:
Usage: glosharp-cli <command> [options]

Commands:
  process <file>    Process a C# file and output JSON metadata
  verify <dir>      Verify all .cs files in a directory compile
  render <file>     Render a C# file as self-contained HTML
  init              Create a glosharp.config.json with defaults

Options:
  --stdin             Read source from stdin
  --framework <tfm>   Target framework (e.g., net8.0)
  --project <path>    Project (.csproj or directory) for NuGet resolution
  --region <name>     Extract a named #region from the source file
  --no-restore        Skip automatic dotnet restore
  --cache-dir <path>  Directory for disk-based result caching
  --complog <path>    Complog file for portable compilation (no SDK needed)
  --complog-project <name>  Project to select from multi-project complog
  --config <path>     Path to glosharp.config.json (default: auto-discover)

Render options:
  --theme <name>      Color theme (github-dark, github-light; default: github-dark)
  --standalone        Output a full HTML page instead of a fragment
  --output <path>     Write HTML to a file instead of stdout
